description: A local-first memory and learning system for AI coding agents, with an MCP server for Claude Code.
releaseNotes: 2.5.0 makes every automatic capture default to pending your approval instead of going straight to Active — reply yes/no in chat, or "yes to all" for the conversation, resolved via the new `resolve_pending_capture` MCP tool or `agentrecall rules approve/archive --all-pending`. `InteractiveMemoryMode: Silent` remains the global bypass. Full notes: https://github.com/AkbarDizaji/AgentRecall/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
